title: Five constituencies. Twenty-five wards. One county.
intro: Joyce served all of Bomet County in the National Assembly as Woman Representative from 2017 to 2022. In 2027 she is standing for Member of Parliament for Bomet Central: Silibwet Township, Singorwet, Chesoen, Mutarakwa and Ndaraweta.

ngaaf.title: What an MP does for Bomet Central
ngaaf.body: A Member of Parliament represents the constituency in the National Assembly, making laws, approving the national budget and holding government to account, and works with the constituency's National Government Constituencies Development Fund (NG-CDF) on bursaries, schools and local projects.
